annotations.title: Rename an account or set its last 4 digits

description: Give an account a real name and the last 4 digits of its card or number. The digits are what matches an imported statement to the right account, and what identifies a card charge on a bank statement, so they are worth asking for. Account ids come from document_info.

kind.description: One of CREDIT_CARD, BANK, CASH, HOLDINGS, if it was created as the wrong one. HOLDINGS is an account with holdings — a broker, a savings account; `set_place_accounts` then names it from the place its money is shown in.

last4.description: The last four digits, as digits.

name.description: A name the user will recognise, e.g. "Cal – Visa 1234".

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: update_account
title: Rename an account or set its last 4 digits
